hero.heading: One declarative API behind everything.
hero.lead: Every resource in Crustates has a spec you write and a status the platform reports. The console, the crust CLI, the terminal UI, the OpenTofu provider, the MCP server and the AI assistant are all clients of the same API.

how.heading: Kubernetes-shaped, without Kubernetes underneath.
how.lead: Resources look familiar: kind, metadata, spec and status. You change the spec, reconcilers on each node make it true, and status reports back. Watch streams push every change as it happens.

steps.title: Write the spec
steps.body: PUT or PATCH a resource. Every write is validated against the OpenAPI schema and checked against your role.

steps.title: Dry run first
steps.body: Add ?dryRun=true to see the diff and its impact before anything changes. The assistant uses the same call.

steps.title: The node agent acts
steps.body: The control plane hands work to the node agent over mTLS gRPC. It drives QEMU, Kata, ZFS, Caddy and the rest.

steps.title: Status streams back
steps.body: Subscribe with ?watch=true for server-sent events. The console and TUI update live from the same stream.

rows.tide: VM, App, Template, Image, ISO, Secret
rows.reef: Pool, Dataset, Share, Bucket, BackupJob, Snapshot, Database
rows.current: Network, FirewallRule, Route, Domain, Certificate, AccessProvider

clients.heading: Click it, script it or let an agent do it.

cli.title: crust CLI
cli.body: One binary for every resource, with tab completion, JSON or YAML output and --dry-run on every change.

tui.title: Terminal UI
tui.body: crust tui gives you live resource lists, logs and consoles over SSH or the local recovery console. Keyboard first.

tofu.title: OpenTofu provider
tofu.body: Manage your homelab as code, with plans you can review in Git. Works with Terraform too.

mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.body: Exposes the API as MCP tools for Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other agents. Same roles, same plan-and-confirm, same audit log.

sdks.title: SDKs
sdks.body: Generated from the OpenAPI spec: Rust, TypeScript, Go and Python. Permissively licensed, so you can embed them anywhere.

events.title: Webhooks and events
events.body: Send events like app.updated or pool.degraded to your own endpoints, ntfy or Home Assistant.

scalar.heading: Try every endpoint from your browser.
scalar.lead: Each node serves an interactive Scalar API reference at /docs, generated from the same code that serves the API. Sign in and send real requests, or copy them as curl, Rust or TypeScript.
scalar.summary: Create a snapshot of a dataset or a VM disk.

access.heading: Tokens, roles and an audit trail.

items.title: Scoped tokens
items.body: Create tokens per tool with a role, an expiry and an optional IP range.

items.title: Roles
items.body: Admin, operator and viewer to start, plus custom roles per area.

items.title: Audit log
items.body: Every write records who, what, when and through which client.

items.title: Versioned
items.body: v1 is stable within a major release; deprecations get a full release of notice.
